title: Harmonic Architecture
subtitle: Test your understanding of Harmonic Architecture — how intentional sound frequencies, sound masonry, and aetheric harvesting grow structures on planetary nodes.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Harmonic buildings were grown on the footprints of crystalline healing temples and drew wireless current from the aether. Replacing 432Hz with 440Hz acoustic dissonance, together with pineal calcification through public water fluoridation, severed the link between human consciousness, those buildings, and the aether. Sound masonry and solfeggio resonance remain the blueprint for re-engaging planetary energy nodes without fossil fuel infrastructure.

questions.question: By what primary mechanism were true harmonic architectural edifices constructed upon primary planetary nodes?

options.label: A
options.text: Combustion-driven thermal masonry fused glass and iron directly onto foundation stones, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: Assembly used frequency manipulation without combustion, fuel lines, or thermal fusing.

options.label: B
options.text: These stone, iron, and glass edifices were harmonically grown and dressed by projecting intentional sound frequencies into the realm's natural aether.
options.rationale: Stone, iron, and glass edifices were harmonically grown and dressed by projecting intentional sound frequencies into the realm's natural aether.

options.label: C
options.text: Liquid geopolymer stone was cast inside metallic scaffolding aligned to planetary grid lines, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Stone was dressed by sound levitation and resonant frequency, not poured in geopolymer molds.

options.label: D
options.text: Pre-cut granite blocks were assembled with mechanical pulleys, hydraulic lifts, and scaffold crews, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Harmonic edifices were grown and dressed by sound frequencies in the aether, not by pulley assembly.

questions.hint: The edifices were grown by sound directed into the natural aether, without hammers or pulleys.

options.rationale: The nodes hosted crystalline healing temples, not manual astronomical markers.

questions.hint: Those first structures stood on the nodes and were later capped with heavy stone shells.
